PullRequest.Title: Language Models editor: honor maxContextWindowTokens in Context Size
PullRequest.Body:
Fixes #348370

### What
The Language Models editor showed a different context size than the chat input for models that declare `maxContextWindowTokens`. With `maxInputTokens: 77000`, `maxOutputTokens: 8192` and `maxContextWindowTokens: 65536`, the chat input showed 66K but the Context Size column showed 85K.

### Why
The editor computed the size as `maxInputTokens + maxOutputTokens` in three places (the Context Size cell and its hover, the model hover, and the row aria label), ignoring the declared window. The chat input and model picker already use `getModelContextWindowTotal`, which prefers the declared window.

### How
- All three editor surfaces now call `getModelContextWindowTotal(metadata)` and show the value only when it's non-zero, matching the model picker card and hover.
- Models without `maxContextWindowTokens` keep the input + output sum. A model that only declares a window now shows it, where it used to show nothing.
- The model-row aria label moved unchanged into an exported `getModelAriaLabel` so it can be tested. Both hovers append the count as text rather than markdown.
- The chat input can additionally apply a user-configured input limit. Like the model picker, the editor shows the model's declared window and doesn't model that limit.

### Evidence
A new test in `chatModelsWidget.test.ts` renders the real `TokenLimitsColumnRenderer` and snapshots the cell, cell hover, model hover and aria label for five metadata cases:

| Case | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| 77000 / 8192 / window 65536 (issue repro) | 85K | 66K |
| 8192 / 4096, no window | 12K | 12K |
| window 100000 only | hidden | 100K |
| no limits | hidden | hidden |
| 8192 / 4096 / window 0 | 12K | hidden |

Validation:
- `scripts\test.bat --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/chatManagement/chatModelsWidget.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/widget/input/modelPicker/modelPickerCard.test.ts`: passed, 152 tests.
- The same new test with the old sums temporarily restored: failed as expected, showing 85K.
- `pnpm run oxlint` on the changed files: passed.
- `pnpm run typecheck-client`: passed.

Not run: a manual check in a running build with a provider that returns these values.

Full report with the plan, reviews and evidence: [engineer report](https://aka.ms/publish?a=81c55dea-2882-439b-89dc-a05e587b2537) (Microsoft internal)
